If they want an agreement, they should negotiate; if they want $6 gas, they should stand firm and bluff until the grass grows under their feet. Iran does not bow to force or threats. title.en: Rubio says 'solid' Iran deal may come on Monday
title.zh: 鲁比奥称“稳固”的伊朗协议可能周一达成

summary.en: US media reports indicate that a potential deal for a 60-day ceasefire extension in the region is under discussion, which would also involve the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz.
summary.zh: 美国媒体报道称，一项可能达成的协议正在讨论中，该协议将包括延长60天停火，并重新开放霍尔木兹海峡。

body.en:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio says US and Iranian negotiators have "a pretty solid thing on the table" and a deal to end the war between the two countries may be reached on Monday.

He was speaking after President Donald Trump said he had instructed negotiators "not to rush into a deal", after earlier suggesting one was close.

It reportedly involves a 60-day ceasefire extension, reopening the Strait of Hormuz and a plan for further negotiations over Iran's nuclear programme.

Oil prices fell sharply and Asian stock markets rose on Monday on hopes of an agreement.

"We're still a work in progress. As I said, you know, we thought we might have some news last night. Maybe today," Rubio said on Monday in the Indian capital, Delhi.

"So we have, what I think is a pretty solid thing on the table in terms of their ability to open up the Straits," he said referring to the Strait of Hormuz - the crucial waterway where 20% of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas passes and which Iran has been blocking.

Cautioning "I wouldn't read too much into it", Rubio said "it takes a little while to hear back from Iran".

CBS News, the BBC's US partner, has reported that US intelligence believes Iran's supreme leader - who was injured in an Israeli strike on the first day of the war - is holed up in an undisclosed location, making communication with his envoys difficult and therefore delaying pace of talks with the US.

Iran's foreign ministry spokesperson Esmail Baghaei said at the weekend the two sides were both "very close and very far" from reaching an agreement.

According to US media, the mooted deal is not a final settlement and instead leaves some of the thorniest issues to be negotiated later, including the scope and timing of Iranian sanctions relief, the release of frozen Iranian funds, and Washington's demands for Iran to curb its nuclear ambitions.

The reported deal has split Trump's Republicans, with some publicly arguing it is too lenient on Iran.

Senator Ted Cruz said it would be "a disastrous mistake", while Roger Wicker, who chairs the Senate Armed Services Committee, said a 60-day ceasefire would mean "everything accomplished by Operation Epic Fury would be for naught!"

Senator Lindsey Graham, who is a close Trump ally, also criticised any deal that would leave Iran perceived as being a dominant force in the region.

Trump responded by saying he did not "listen to the losers, who are critical about something they know nothing about".

"If I make a deal with Iran, it will be a good and proper one," he wrote on Truth Social.

The US and Israel launched wide-ranging strikes on Iran on 28 February, sparking conflict across the Middle East. Iran responded by attacking Israel and US-allied states in the Gulf, and effectively closed the Strait of...
body.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥表示，美国和伊朗谈判代表“摆在桌面上的事情非常可靠”，两国可能会在周一达成一项结束战争的协议。 在他发表此番言论之前，唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，他已指示谈判代表“不要急于达成协议”，此前他曾暗示已经接近达成协议。 据报道，协议涉及延长停火60天、重新开放霍尔木兹海峡以及就伊朗核计划进行进一步谈判的计划。 由于达成协议的希望，油价大幅下跌，亚洲股市周一上涨。 “我们的工作仍在进行中。正如我所说，你知道，我们认为昨晚可能会得到一些消息。也许今天，”卢比奥周一在印度首都德里表示。 “所以，我认为就他们开放海峡的能力而言，我们已经摆在桌面上，”他指的是霍尔木兹海峡。世界上20%的石油和液化天然气都经过这条重要的水道，而伊朗一直在封锁这条海峡。 卢比奥警告称“我不会对此进行太多解读”，并表示“需要一段时间才能收到伊朗的回复”。 英国广播公司(BBC)的美国合作伙伴哥伦比亚广播公司新闻报道称，美国情报部门认为，伊朗最高领导人——在战争第一天在以色列的袭击中受伤——躲藏在一个秘密地点，这使得与其特使的沟通变得困难，从而推迟了与美国的谈判进度。 伊朗外交部发言人埃斯梅尔·巴格哈伊(Esmail Baghaei)周末表示，双方距离达成协议“非常接近但又非常遥远”。 美国媒体称，拟议中的协议并不是最终解决方案，而是将一些最棘手的问题留待以后进行谈判，包括伊朗制裁解除的范围和时间、释放冻结的伊朗资金以及华盛顿要求伊朗遏制其核野心。 报道称，特朗普的共和党人对此产生了分歧，一些人公开认为该协议对伊朗过于宽容。 参议员泰德·克鲁兹表示，这将是“一个灾难性的错误”，而参议院军事委员会主席罗杰·威克则表示，60 天的停火将意味着“史诗愤怒行动所取得的一切都将化为乌有！” 特朗普的亲密盟友、参议员林赛·格雷厄姆也批评任何会让伊朗被视为该地区主导力量的协议。 特朗普回应称，他没有“听取失败者的意见，他们对自己一无所知的事情持批评态度”。 “如果我与伊朗达成协议，这将是一项良好且适当的协议，”他在《真相社会》上写道。 2月28日，美国和以色列对伊朗发动大范围打击，引发中东冲突。伊朗的回应是攻击以色列和美国在海湾的盟国，并有效关闭了海峡...

reflection.en: Even temporary ceasefires and diplomatic efforts, like the one being discussed, are vital steps towards alleviating suffering and creating space for dialogue. Such initiatives remind us of the call to be peacemakers in a world often marked by conflict.
reflection.zh: 即使是暂时的停火和外交努力，如正在讨论的这项协议，也是缓解苦难和为对话创造空间的至关重要的一步。这样的举措提醒我们，在一个常常充满冲突的世界中，要努力成为缔造和平的人。

verse.textEn: Blessed are the peacemakers, for they will be called children of God.
verse.textZh: 使人和睦的人有福了，因为他们必称为神的儿子。

title.en: Australia news live: Liberal MP is first to be suspended from lower house in five years; last IS-linked women and children to return to Australia
title.zh: 澳大利亚政治直播：扎利·斯特格尔证实“青色联盟”正在进行“对话”，引发关于新政党的猜测

summary.en: Independent Australian politicians, known as "teals," are discussing forming a new political party to more effectively hold the government accountable. These conversations are partly influenced by recent electoral reforms and a broader desire to enhance governmental oversight.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚独立政治家，被称为“青色联盟”，正在讨论组建新政党，以更有效地追究政府的责任。这些讨论部分受到近期选举改革和更广泛地加强政府监督的愿望影响。

body.en: Phil Thompson was suspended fter refusing to withdraw comments calling the Albanese government ‘liars’. Follow today’s news live Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Were the teal party conversations sparked by the government’s electoral reforms? Yes and no, Allegra Spender and Zali Steggall say. There are many things that favour major party structures, and again, the public was incredibly cynical about that move, that it’s yet again major parties trying to rig the game for their benefit. I have had conversations over a period of time about how politics could evolve because people keep on coming to me and say they really worried about the times that we’re in. The question is: look, are there ways to better collaborate to evolve and how we work together or how some of us work together so that we can more explicitly align on certain areas and then where our communities and where we fundamentally disagree to have that freedom. Continue reading...
body.zh: 扎利·斯蒂格尔表示，蒂尔斯希望“更有效地让政府承担责任”。关注今天的新闻直播 青色政党的对话是由政府的选举改革引发的吗？是的，也不是，阿莱格拉·斯彭德和扎利·斯特格尔说。有很多事情有利于主要政党结构，公众对这一举动再次表示难以置信的愤世嫉俗，认为主要政党再次试图为了自己的利益而操纵游戏。一段时间以来，我一直在讨论政治如何演变，因为人们不断来找我，说他们真的很担心我们所处的时代。问题是：看看，有没有办法更好地合作发展，我们如何合作，或者我们中的一些人如何合作，以便我们能够在某些领域以及我们的社区和我们从根本上不同意的领域达成一致，从而获得这种自由。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The desire to hold government accountable reflects a deep concern for the well-being of the people. When leaders govern with integrity and wisdom, society flourishes, but when they fail, the community often suffers. This pursuit of effective oversight is a vital part of ensuring a nation's health and prosperity.
reflection.zh: 渴望让政府承担责任，反映出对人民福祉的深切关注。当领导者以正直和智慧治理时，社会就会繁荣；而当他们失职时，社区往往会受苦。这种追求有效监督的做法，是确保国家健康和繁荣的重要组成部分。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: Nacc chief Paul Brereton resigns as head of anti-corruption body
title.zh: 国家反腐败委员会主席保罗·布雷顿辞职

summary.en: Paul Brereton, Australia's inaugural national anti-corruption commissioner, announced his resignation effective July, stating that personal scrutiny was diverting attention from the commission's core mission.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚首任国家反腐败委员会主席保罗·布雷顿宣布将于七月辞职，他表示，对个人事务的持续关注正在分散委员会的核心使命。

body.en: Brereton says ‘ongoing focus on matters relating to me personally’ were ‘drawing attention away from the commission’s core purpose’ Paul Brereton, Australia’s first national anti-corruption commissioner, will step down from the top job in July, citing criticism of potential conflicts of interest as “drawing attention away” from the body’s core purpose. In a statement on Monday afternoon, Brereton said the “ongoing focus on matters relating to me personally” were “drawing attention away from the commission’s core purpose of strengthening integrity”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 布雷尔顿表示，“持续关注与我个人相关的问题”正在“将注意力从委员会的核心目标上转移开”。澳大利亚首任国家反腐败专员保罗·布雷尔顿 (Paul Brereton) 将于 7 月辞去最高职务，理由是对潜在利益冲突的批评“将注意力从委员会的核心目标上转移开”。布雷尔顿在周一下午的一份声明中表示，“持续关注与我个人相关的问题”正在“转移人们对委员会加强诚信这一核心目标的注意力”。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Leaders in positions of public trust, especially those combating corruption, carry a heavy burden of integrity. When personal matters threaten to overshadow their vital work, stepping aside can be a difficult but necessary act to preserve the institution's credibility. This reminds us that true authority is built on a foundation of righteousness, not just...
reflection.zh: 担任公职并肩负反腐重任的领导者，其诚信至关重要。当个人事务可能掩盖其重要工作时，退位可能是一个艰难但必要的举动，以维护机构的公信力。这提醒我们，真正的权威是建立在公义而非权力之上的。

verse.textEn: Kings detest wrongdoing, for a throne is established through righteousness.
verse.textZh: 作恶为王所憎恶，因国位是靠公义坚立。

title.en: Bondi beach gunmen shot 11 people within 30 seconds of opening fire, royal commission hears
title.zh: 皇家委员会获悉，邦迪海滩枪手在开火30秒内射伤11人

summary.en: A royal commission has heard that gunmen shot 11 people within 30 seconds of opening fire at Bondi Beach. It was also revealed that NSW police had declined to provide a static presence at a Chanukah event, though four officers were present when the attack began.
summary.zh: 皇家委员会获悉，邦迪海滩的枪手在开火30秒内射伤了11人。委员会还被告知，新南威尔士州警方曾拒绝在“海边光明节”活动中提供固定警力，但在袭击发生时有四名警员在场。

body.en: Commission also told NSW police declined to provide static police presence at Chanukah by the Sea but four officers were at event when attack began Follow our Australia news live blog for latest updates Get our breaking news email , free app or daily news podcast Within 30 seconds of opening fire at Bondi beach on 14 December, two gunmen targeting Jewish Australians had shot 11 people, killing 10 of them, the royal commission into antisemitism and social cohesion has heard. The second block of public hearings opened in Sydney on Monday morning, taking evidence about what was known about the two shooters. A Jewish organisation, the Community Security Group, asked NSW police to provide a static police presence at the Chanukah by the Sea event for the entirety of the celebration. NSW police declined to provide a static police presence for the entire event, instead allocating a “mobile tasking, that is police officers were instructed to attend the event from time to time during the evening”. At the time the two gunmen opened fire on Jewish community members, there were four police at Archer Park. Within 29 seconds of the start of the shooting, 11 people had been shot, 10 of them fatally. Three police officers were shot and injured in the court of the attack. Within five minutes, there were 11 police officers on the scene. The first shooter was shot and killed and the second shooter was shot and apprehended within seven minutes and 41 seconds after the start of the shooting. Continue reading...
body.zh: 委员会还告诉新南威尔士州警方拒绝在光明节海边派驻警力，但袭击开始时有四名警官在场。 关注我们的澳大利亚新闻直播博客，了解最新动态 获取我们的突发新闻电子邮件、免费应用程序或每日新闻播客 12 月 14 日，在邦迪海滩开枪后 30 秒内，两名针对犹太澳大利亚人的枪手开枪射杀了 11 人，其中 10 人死亡，皇家反犹太主义和社会凝聚力委员会获悉。第二场公开听证会于周一上午在悉尼开幕，收集有关两名枪手已知情况的证据。犹太组织社区安全组织要求新南威尔士州警方在光明节海边活动的整个庆祝活动期间提供静态警力驻守。新南威尔士州警方拒绝在整个活动中提供静态警力，而是分配了“移动任务，即指示警察在晚上不时参加活动”。当两名枪手向犹太社区成员开枪时，阿彻公园有四名警察。枪击事件发生后29秒内，已有11人中枪，其中10人死亡。三名警察在袭击法庭中被枪杀。 5分钟内，11名警察赶到现场。枪击开始后7分41秒内，第一名枪手被击毙，第二名枪手被枪杀并被捕。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid, devastating violence described in this report is a stark reminder of the destructive power unleashed when individuals resort to arms. Jesus' words in Matthew 26:52 serve as a timeless warning about the inherent danger and tragic consequences of choosing violence. Such acts wound not only victims but also the fabric of society, perpetuating cycles...
reflection.zh: 这份报告中描述的迅速而毁灭性的暴力，严峻地提醒我们，当个人诉诸武力时所释放的破坏力。耶稣在马太福音26:52中的话语，是对选择暴力的内在危险和悲惨后果的永恒警告。此类行为不仅伤害受害者，也撕裂社会结构，使痛苦的循环持续下去。

verse.textEn: All who draw the sword will die by the sword.
verse.textZh: 凡动刀的，必死在刀下。

title.en: Venezuela inmates occupy prison roof and set fire to mattresses to protest alleged abuses
title.zh: 委内瑞拉囚犯占领监狱屋顶并点燃床垫，抗议涉嫌虐待

summary.en: Inmates at Venezuela's Barinas prison protested alleged abuses by staff, occupying the roof and setting mattresses on fire. Prison officials reportedly opened fire on the peacefully protesting inmates, causing injuries.
summary.zh: 委内瑞拉巴里纳斯监狱的囚犯为抗议涉嫌的虐待行为，占领了监狱屋顶并点燃床垫。据报道，监狱工作人员向和平抗议的囚犯开火，造成一些人受伤。

body.en: Inmates at Barinas prison allege they were peacefully protesting when prison staff opened fire, leaving some wounded Inmates at Venezuela’s western Barinas prison staged a protest on its roof on Sunday, piling flaming mattresses and calling for the removal of the facility’s director, who they accused of overseeing guards as they shot unarmed prisoners. “We want justice. They are shooting us, the guards and the wardens,” a prisoner said in a video shared by the Venezuelan Observatory of Prisons, a local NGO, on X, in which a man is seen with a bullet wound in his chest. Continue reading...
body.zh: 巴里纳斯监狱的囚犯声称，他们当时正在进行和平抗议，监狱工作人员开枪，造成一些受伤。周日，委内瑞拉西部巴里纳斯监狱的囚犯在屋顶上举行抗议活动，他们堆放燃烧的床垫，并要求撤换监狱长，他们指责监狱长在射杀手无寸铁的囚犯时监督狱警。 “我们想要正义。他们向我们、看守和典狱长开枪，”一名囚犯在当地非政府组织委内瑞拉监狱观察站在 X 上分享的视频中说道，视频中可以看到一名男子胸部中弹。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The desperate protest by inmates against alleged abuses highlights a profound breakdown of justice within the prison system. Jeremiah reminds those in authority of their sacred duty to "do what is just and right" and protect the vulnerable from oppression and violence. This divine mandate calls for accountability and compassion, especially towards those who...
reflection.zh: 囚犯们为抗议涉嫌的虐待而进行的绝望抗议，凸显了监狱系统内司法公正的严重缺失。雅伟通过耶利米提醒掌权者，他们有神圣的职责去“施行公平和公义”，保护弱势群体免受压迫和暴力。这一神圣的命令呼吁对那些最边缘化的人负起责任并施以怜悯。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: Oil prices slide on hopes of US-Iran peace deal
title.zh: 对美伊和平协议的希望推动油价下跌

summary.en: Oil prices fell following President Trump's announcement that a potential peace agreement with Iran would include the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. No further details about the agreement were provided.
summary.zh: 在特朗普总统宣布与伊朗可能达成和平协议，其中包括重新开放霍尔木兹海峡后，油价下跌。协议的更多细节尚未公布。

body.en:
Oil prices have fallen sharply and Asian stock markets have risen on hopes of a deal that could bring an end to the US-Israel war with Iran.

On Saturday, US President Donald Trump said an agreement with Tehran had been "largely negotiated" and details would be announced soon but the following day urged his negotiating team not to rush a deal .

On Monday in Asia, global oil benchmark Brent was down by 5.5% at $97.90 (£72.64), while US-traded crude was 5.9% lower at $90.93.

Trump had previously said the deal would include the reopening of the key Strait of Hormuz shipping route, without giving further details.

The narrow waterway, through which around a fifth of the world's oil and liquefied natural gas (LNG) usually passes, has been effectively closed since the conflict started on 28 February.

The Nikkei 225 stock index in Japan rose above 65,000 for the first time after gaining 3% on hopes that the strait would soon reopen.

Japan, like nearby South Korea, has been particularly impacted by the conflict as they are heavily reliant on energy from the Gulf.

UK and US energy and financial markets are closed on Monday for public holidays.

Trump said on social media on Saturday that he had a "very good call" with the leaders of Saudi Arabia, the United Arab Emirates, Qatar, and others about a "Memorandum of Understanding pertaining to PEACE".

"An agreement has been largely negotiated, subject to finalization between the United States of America, the Islamic Republic of Iran, and the various other Countries, as listed," Trump said.

"Final aspects and details of the deal are currently being discussed, and will be announced shortly."

He also said he had a call on Saturday with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, which "went very well".

The president did not give any further details on the deal, but has insisted any agreement would "absolutely" prevent Iran from obtaining a nuclear weapon.

But on Sunday, he said on Truth Social: "Both sides must take their time and get it right. There can be no mistakes!"

Iranian foreign ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baqaei earlier told state television that US and Iranian positions had been converging in the last week, but warned that did not mean agreements would be reached on key issues and accused the Americans of "contradictory statements".

Global energy markets have seen big price swings since early March after Iran threatened to attack ships trying to use the Strait of Hormuz in retaliation for US and Israeli attacks on the country.

While crude oil prices have fallen sharply today they remain significantly higher than before the war.

Tehran also attacked Israel and US-allied states in the Gulf, including Saudi Arabia, Bahrain and the United Arab Emirates.

body.zh: 由于希望达成一项能够结束美以与伊朗战争的协议，油价大幅下跌，亚洲股市上涨。 周六，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示，与德黑兰的协议已经“基本通过谈判”，细节将很快公布，但第二天敦促他的谈判团队不要仓促达成协议。 周一在亚洲，全球石油基准布伦特原油下跌 5.5%，至 97.90 美元（72.64 英镑），而美国交易的原油下跌 5.9%，至 90.93 美元。 特朗普此前曾表示，该协议将包括重新开放重要的霍尔木兹海峡航线，但没有透露更多细节。 这条狭窄的水道通常是世界上约五分之一的石油和液化天然气 (LNG) 所经过的，自 2 月 28 日冲突爆发以来，这条水道已被有效关闭。 日本日经 225 股指在因海峡很快重新开放的希望而上涨 3% 后首次突破 65,000 点。 日本和附近的韩国一样，受到冲突的影响尤其严重，因为它们严重依赖海湾能源。 英国和美国能源和金融市场周一因公共假期休市。 特朗普周六在社交媒体上表示，他与沙特阿拉伯、阿联酋、卡塔尔等国领导人就“有关和平的谅解备忘录”进行了“非常好的通话”。 特朗普表示：“一项协议已基本通过谈判，有待美利坚合众国、伊朗伊斯兰共和国和所列其他国家之间最终敲定。” “交易的最终方面和细节目前正在讨论，并将很快公布。” 他还表示，他周六与以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡进行了通话，“进展顺利”。 总统没有提供有关该协议的任何进一步细节，但坚称任何协议都将“绝对”阻止伊朗获得核武器。 但周日，他在《Truth Social》上表示：“双方都必须慢慢来，把事情做好。不能有任何错误！” 伊朗外交部发言人伊斯梅尔·巴卡伊(Esmaeil Baqaei)早些时候对国家电视台表示，美国和伊朗的立场在上周已经趋同，但警告称，这并不意味着会在关键问题上达成协议，并指责美国人的“相互矛盾的言论”。 自 3 月初以来，伊朗威胁要攻击试图使用霍尔木兹海峡的船只，以报复美国和以色列对该国的袭击，全球能源市场价格大幅波动。 尽管原油价格今天大幅下跌，但仍明显高于战前。 德黑兰还袭击了以色列和美国在海湾地区的盟国，包括沙特阿拉伯、巴林和阿拉伯联合酋长国。 四月初达成停火协议，并且......

reflection.en: The hope for a peace deal between nations, leading to the reopening of vital waterways, reminds us of the profound desire for a world where conflict gives way to cooperation. This vision echoes the ancient prophecy of a time when instruments of war would be transformed into tools for peaceful productivity.
reflection.zh: 国际间和平协议的希望，以及重要航道的重新开放，提醒我们对一个冲突消弭、合作共赢的世界的深切渴望。这与古老的预言不谋而合，预示着一个战争工具将被转化为和平生产工具的时代。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Why are Europe's biggest defense projects in trouble?
title.zh: 欧洲最大的国防项目为何陷入困境？

summary.en: Disputes over leadership, military priorities and industrial control are threatening to fracture Europe's €100 billion fighter jet project — with tensions now spilling into a Franco-German tank project as well.
summary.zh: 围绕领导权、军事优先事项和工业控制权的争议，正威胁着欧洲耗资1000亿欧元的战斗机项目，紧张局势也蔓延到了法德坦克项目。

body.en:
Disputes over leadership, military priorities and industrial control are threatening to fracture Europe's €100 billion fighter jet project — with tensions now spilling into a Franco-German tank project as well.

Europe wanted to build a joint next-generation fighter jet. Instead, the bloc's  biggest defense project may now produce two separate warplanes.

Airbus , which represents the German and Spanish side of the Future Combat Air System (FCAS), told DW it is open to restructuring the program after years of political and industrial disputes. 

That could include a "two-fighter solution" allowing France and Germany to develop separate combat aircraft while still cooperating on drones, sensors and the digital systems linking the battlefield in real time.

The twist: the fighter jet itself may no longer be the project's most important part.

The proposal marks a serious shift for a project once billed as a symbol of Franco-German military unity .

"On FCAS, work is ongoing with the French, German and Spanish governments to decide on the project's way forward," an Airbus spokesperson told DW.

Airbus Chief Executive Guillaume Faury said the wider program still makes sense, even if the fighter jet at its center remains blocked.

"The deadlock of a single pillar should not jeopardize the entire future of this high-tech European capability," he said, adding that Airbus would support a two-fighter option if governments asked for it. 

The dispute is now raising a wider question: Can Europe's biggest powers still build major weapons systems together?

FCAS was launched by France and Germany in 2017, with Spain joining later. Valued at roughly €100 billion ($116 bn), the project aims to deliver a sixth-generation air combat system by around 2040.

The program goes far beyond a next-generation fighter jet. It also includes drones, remote carriers, engines and a "combat cloud" designed to connect aircraft, sensors and battlefield data in real time.

France wants the future aircraft to operate from aircraft carriers and carry nuclear weapons. Being a non-nuclear power itself, Germany does not share those requirements. Berlin has already decided to buy US-made F-35 fighter jets for NATO nuclear-sharing missions.

German Chancellor Friedrich Merz recently acknowledged the divide publicly. He said France needed a nuclear-capable next-generation aircraft, while Germany did not currently require the same capability for the Bundeswehr . If the two sides could not resolve those differences, he warned, "then we can't maintain the project."

body.zh: 关于领导权、军事优先事项和工业控制的争端正威胁着欧洲耗资 1000 亿欧元的战斗机项目，紧张局势现在也蔓延到了法德坦克项目。 欧洲希望联合建造下一代战斗机。 相反，欧盟最大的国防项目现在可能会生产两架独立的战机。 代表未来作战空中系统（FCAS）德国和西班牙方面的空中客车公司告诉德国之声，经过多年的政治和工业纠纷，该公司愿意重组该项目。 这可能包括“双战斗机解决方案”，允许法国和德国开发单独的战斗机，同时仍然在无人机、传感器和实时连接战场的数字系统方面进行合作。 变化是：战斗机本身可能不再是该项目最重要的部分。 该提案标志着这个曾经被誉为法德军事团结象征的项目发生了重大转变。 空客发言人告诉德国之声：“关于FCAS，我们正在与法国、德国和西班牙政府合作，以决定该项目的前进方向。” 空中客车公司首席执行官纪尧姆·福里表示，即使中心的战斗机仍被封锁，更广泛的计划仍然有意义。 他说：“单一支柱的僵局不应危及欧洲高科技能力的整个未来。”他补充说，如果政府要求，空客将支持两架战斗机的选择。 这场争端现在引发了一个更广泛的问题：欧洲最大的强国还能共同建造主要武器系统吗？ FCAS由法国和德国于2017年推出，西班牙随后加入。该项目价值约 1000 亿欧元（1160 亿美元），目标是在 2040 年左右交付第六代空战系统。 该计划远远超出了下一代战斗机的范围。它还包括无人机、远程载体、发动机和旨在实时连接飞机、传感器和战场数据的“战斗云”。 法国希望未来的飞机能够在航空母舰上运行并携带核武器。德国本身就是一个无核国家，因此不同意这些要求。柏林已经决定购买美制F-35战斗机用于北约核共享任务。 德国总理弗里德里希·梅尔茨最近公开承认了这种分歧。他说，法国需要具有核能力的下一代飞机，而德国目前不需要德国联邦国防军具有相同的能力。他警告说，如果双方无法解决这些分歧，“那么我们就无法维持该项目。” 阵风战斗机的法国制造商达索航空公司希望对新型战斗机拥有明确的领导权。空客防务与航天公司代表德国和西班牙的工业利益，并希望...

reflection.en: This story highlights how even strategically important projects can falter when leaders are divided by disputes over control and priorities. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us that without wise guidance, plans and even nations can fail, but safety is found in a multitude of counselors. It underscores the importance of collaboration and shared vision for navigating...
reflection.zh: 这个故事揭示了当领导者因控制权和优先事项的争议而分裂时，即使是具有战略意义的项目也会受阻。箴言11:14提醒我们，没有明智的指导，计划甚至国家都可能失败，但在众多的谋士中才有安全。这强调了在应对复杂挑战和实现共同目标时，协作和共同愿景的重要性。

verse.textEn: For lack of guidance a nation falls, but victory is won through many advisers.
verse.textZh: 无智谋，民就败落；谋士多，人便安居。

title.en: Large-scale Russian attack on Ukraine leaves four dead and dozens injured
title.zh: 俄罗斯对乌克兰发动大规模袭击，造成四人死亡，数十人受伤

summary.en: Russia has confirmed a large-scale attack on Ukraine, utilizing a hypersonic missile reportedly traveling over ten times the speed of sound. The assault resulted in four fatalities and dozens of injuries.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯已证实对乌克兰发动大规模袭击，使用了据称速度超过音速十倍的高超音速导弹。此次袭击造成四人死亡，数十人受伤。

body.en:
Russia carried out a deadly large-scale wave of strikes against Ukraine, firing hundreds of drones and dozens of missiles on Saturday night.

Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said Kyiv was the main target, but other areas were also hit, with about 100 people injured.

Four people were killed in the capital and wider region, with explosions heard throughout the night. Dozens of residential buildings, a school, an opera house and a museum were damaged.

Russia's defence ministry said the Oreshnik hypersonic missile was used in the strikes, which it described as coming in response to Ukraine's "attacks on civilian infrastructure". Ukraine's military denies targeting civilians.

Early on Monday, energy infrastructure was damaged in a missile attack on Russia's Belgorod region bordering Ukraine, including the city of Belgorod, the Interfax news agency reported, citing local authorities.

There were no casualties but power and water supply were interrupted, Interfax said. It did not provide further details.

Russia's Yaroslavl region, northeast of Moscow, also came under under a drone attack, the Governor Mikhail Yevrayev said on Telegram.

Russian President Vladimir Putin launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

He accused Kyiv of hitting a student dormitory in the town of Starobilsk on Friday, in which Russian officials said 21 people were killed.

Ukraine's military said its forces did carry out an attack in Starobilsk in Russian-occupied eastern Ukraine overnight on Friday, but maintained that it struck an elite Russian drone military unit.

European leaders have condemned the Russian strikes early on Sunday, which came after warnings from Zelensky that Russia was planning an attack, and that it may have been preparing to use the Oreshnik missile.

It reportedly travels at more than 10 times the speed of sound, is hard to intercept, and is known to be capable of carrying both conventional and nuclear warheads.

Zelensky - who on Sunday visited a number of damaged buildings in Kyiv - said that Russia had launched the Oreshnik missile against the city of Bila Tserkva in the Kyiv region.

Ukraine's presidential office later said it was not confirming that, saying work was ongoing to determine exactly what had been used.

It would be the third time Russia has used the Oreshnik missile in the conflict.

Both French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Friedrich Merz condemned the reported use of the weapon, while EU foreign policy chief Kaja Kallas described it as a "political scare-tactic and reckless nuclear-brinkmanship".

UK Foreign Secretary Yvette Cooper lamented the "awful scenes" in Kyiv and vowed to "keep up pressure on Russia".

reflection.zh: 大规模袭击和先进武器的消息，常使我们对人类冲突的破坏力感到不知所措。诗篇46:9提醒我们一个神圣的盼望：雅伟是那位“止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓、断枪，把战车焚烧在火中”的神。面对如此破坏，我们紧紧抓住神主权之手带来和平的应许。

title.en: How Saudi Arabia's spending spree reached the end of the line
title.zh: 沙特阿拉伯的“烧钱”狂潮为何走到尽头

summary.en: Saudi Arabia's ambitious Vision 2030 project, once described as science fiction, is now confronting harsh realities, indicating a significant shift in its trajectory.
summary.zh: 沙特阿拉伯雄心勃勃的“2030愿景”项目曾被形容为科幻小说般的存在，如今却面临严峻的现实，预示着其发展轨迹将发生重大转变。

body.en:
Autocratic monarchs once left an echo of their glory in the ruins of the megaprojects they commanded at the peak of their unchallenged power. Those monumental physical traces are to be found in the fertile plains, mountainsides and deserts of the Middle East. But one of their most prominent modern counterparts may only have a digital footprint to leave behind for some of his most ambitious concepts.

A decade ago, the Crown Prince of Saudi Arabia Mohammed bin Salman – or MBS as he is widely known – decreed a revisioning of his country that leapt from the realm of science fiction. It was called Vision 2030. Extraordinary monolithic structures were to help bring forth new technological marvels not just for the Kingdom but for the world.

Those ideas were made manifest in lavish PR material conjuring up fantastical landscapes that attracted reams of coverage that mingled awe and derision. It was made possible by the near $1trn (£744bn) sovereign wealth fund of Saudi Arabia (PIF) whose riches, so dependent on oil, were to be used to create the foundation for a future without oil.

Four years from 2030, there has now been, perhaps predictably, a retrenchment. Part of that is down to financial imperatives, as a big fall in oil prices before the current war in the Middle East meant that even Saudi Arabia's extraordinary wealth took a hit.

Even though those prices have now shot up because of the war, the uncertainty created by the conflict will continue to put constraints on Saudi revenue and spending. And the influx of foreign investment in these hyper-expensive visionary projects has never materialised to the degree on which the Saudis had been banking.

Some of the most striking projects are now being watered down, put on hold or even abandoned. Several come under the once all-embracing umbrella of the $500bn Neom mega-project.

It looks like The Line, which was meant to redefine the concept of a city as it stretched ramrod straight across more than 100 miles (161km) of untapped land in the north west of Saudi Arabia, looming taller than The Shard, is being turned into something considerably more prosaic.

The winter resort of Trojena in the mountains of the north west has also been reined in. There is snow up there, belying the image of Saudi Arabia as an unyielding desert, but it doesn't last very long. The concept of a year-round mountain resort took the area into a realm of artificiality that is no longer seen as viable. There were to have been miles of ski slopes and a full-on ski village with a man-made lake and luxury hotels and shops – a mini St Moritz in the mountains of Arabia. It was meant to have been ready in time to host the Asian Winter Games in 2029, but that has now been cancelled, with the Games to be held in Kazakhstan instead.

title.en: White House shooting suspect identified as update given on injured bystander
title.zh: 白宫枪击案嫌疑人身份确认，受伤旁观者情况更新

summary.en: Court records reveal the suspect Nasire Best had tried to enter White House grounds at a different checkpoint last year.
summary.zh: 法院记录显示，嫌疑人纳西尔·贝斯特去年曾试图从另一个检查站进入白宫。

body.en:
A bystander who was struck by gunfire after a man fired on a checkpoint outside the White House remains in serious but stable condition.

The US Secret Service said the bystander, who has not been identified, suffered a gunshot wound described as not life-threatening. It was not clear how he was shot.

Authorities have released few additional details about the early Saturday evening, local time, shooting. The District of Columbia Metropolitan Police Department said the suspect, identified as 21-year-old Nasire Best, started shooting toward a White House security checkpoint when Secret Service officers returned fire.

It was the third shooting near the president in the past month, after a man stormed the White House Correspondents' Association Dinner in April armed with guns and knives, and Secret Service officers shot and wounded a man who fired at them earlier this month near the Washington Monument.

In a Truth Social post, Trump said the suspect in Saturday's shooting had a "possible obsession with our Country’s most cherished structure".

He also used the shooting to promote the ballroom he is seeking to build on the site of the White House’s former East Wing, saying the shooting "goes to show how important it is, for all future Presidents, to get, what will be, the most safe and secure space of its kind ever built in Washington, D.C".

Trump is asking Congress for US$1 billion ($1.4 billion) for security additions for the White House campus, including the ballroom.

Best had a previous run-in with law enforcement near the White House, according to District of Columbia court records. He was arrested last July for trying to enter White House grounds near a different checkpoint. He failed to heed officers' commands to stop, claimed to be Jesus Christ and said he wanted to be arrested.

Best was a track and field athlete at Dundalk High School in Baltimore, from which he graduated in 2023.

A woman who identified herself as Best’s mother told The Washington Post that she learned about the shooting on social media and was in disbelief.

body.zh: 一名男子在白宫外的检查站遭到枪击，一名旁观者中弹，目前伤势严重但稳定。 美国特勤局表示，这名旁观者的身份尚未确定，他受了枪伤，但没有生命危险。目前尚不清楚他是如何被枪杀的。 当局公布了有关当地时间周六傍晚枪击事件的一些额外细节。哥伦比亚特区警察局表示，21 岁的嫌疑人纳西尔·贝斯特 (Nasire Best) 在特勤局人员还击时开始向白宫安全检查站开枪。 这是过去一个月里总统附近发生的第三起枪击事件，此前一名男子持枪和刀具冲进了白宫记者协会晚宴，本月早些时候，特勤局官员在华盛顿纪念碑附近开枪打伤了一名向他们开枪的男子。 特朗普在《真相社会》的一篇帖子中表示，周六枪击事件的嫌疑人“可能对我们国家最珍贵的建筑有着痴迷”。 他还利用这次枪击事件来宣传他正在白宫前东翼旧址上建造的宴会厅，称这次枪击事件“表明，对于所有未来的总统来说，获得华盛顿特区有史以来最安全的同类空间是多么重要”。 特朗普要求国会拨款 10 亿美元（约合 14 亿美元），用于增加白宫园区（包括舞厅）的安全保障。 根据哥伦比亚特区法院记录，贝斯特此前曾在白宫附近与执法部门发生过冲突。去年七月，他因试图进入另一个检查站附近的白宫场地而被捕。他没有听从警察的停车命令，自称是耶稣基督，并说他想被捕。 贝斯特是巴尔的摩邓多克高中的田径运动员，于 2023 年毕业。 一名自称贝斯特母亲的女士告诉《华盛顿邮报》，她在社交媒体上得知了枪击事件，对此感到难以置信。 如需了解 SBS 新闻的最新动态，请下载我们的应用程序并订阅我们的时事通讯。

While authorities are called to serve justly, citizens are also called to respect the structures that maintain peace. This balance is crucial for a stable and functioning community.
reflection.zh: 有关政府所在地发生闯入未遂事件的消息，提醒我们社会秩序和法治的重要性。虽然当权者被呼召公正服务，公民也被呼召尊重维护和平的结构。这种平衡对于一个稳定和正常运作的社区至关重要。

title.en: Morocco wants tourists to visit Western Sahara. Some say it's tightening its control
title.zh: 摩洛哥希望游客访问西撒哈拉，有人称其正在加强控制

summary.en: The Moroccan government is encouraging more Western tourists to visit Western Sahara, a territory it asserts ownership over.
summary.zh: 摩洛哥政府正鼓励更多西方游客访问西撒哈拉，该地区是摩洛哥声称拥有主权的领土。

body.en:
Back in March, an email landed in my inbox from Irish airline Ryanair asking me if I was ready for my "next Moroccan adventure".

Sprawling along a windswept peninsula where the Sahara meets the Atlantic, the city of Dakhla certainly looked attractive.

I would have to make my way to Madrid first, but from the Spanish capital return flights to Dakhla start from just €30 ($35).

There are dozens of accommodation options too, from hostels to brand new luxury getaways advertising the area as Morocco's hidden gem.

But, despite what the adverts and websites say, any tourist making the trip would be landing in one of the world's longest ongoing territorial disputes.

That is because Dakhla is in Western Sahara, an area which the United Nations classifies as a "non-self-governing territory". By this it means that the local population isn't able to govern itself.

Instead, some 80% of Western Sahara is occupied and administered by Morocco, its northern neighbour. Morocco considers Western Sahara to be part of its sovereign territory, calling it its "southern provinces".

The UN has consistently pushed for a solution to the 50-year dispute, including a referendum, but the indigenous people of the area have never been able to vote for their own future.

Rights groups and legal experts tell the BBC that marketing and labelling Western Sahara as part of Morocco raises serious concerns from an international law perspective, and promotes the legitimisation of Morocco's occupation.

Visitor numbers to Morocco-controlled Western Sahara have risen by more than 50% over the past seven years, data from the Moroccan Ministry of Tourism shows. They jumped from 490,297 in 2019 to 743,133 in 2025.

The boom is being fuelled by expanding air links. Alongside Morocco's national carrier Royal Air Maroc, airlines including Ryanair, Transavia France and Binter Canarias now operate direct routes from Madrid, Paris and the Canary Islands respectively.

Tom Ruck, 29, is one UK tourist who recently flew to Dakhla from Madrid with Ryanair.

"You've got quite a lot of resorts being built, however they were very, very empty " he says.

Ruck adds that there were "a few other tourists knocking about for a summer family holiday kind of thing", but that it "definitely felt like it was in its infancy".

He got a Moroccan stamp in his passport, and says that Morocco's flag flies across the city.

It comes as the Moroccan government has invested heavily in developing tourism in Western Sahara in recent years. This has attracted the airlines, with both Ryanair and Transavia France listing destinations within Western Sahara as being part of Morocco.

Transavia France tells the BBC the firm "operates flights to Dakhla in accordance with the authorisations received from the authorities"....
body.zh: 早在三月份，我的收件箱里就收到一封来自爱尔兰瑞安航空的电子邮件，询问我是否准备好进行“下一次摩洛哥冒险”。 达赫拉市坐落在撒哈拉沙漠与大西洋交汇处的狂风肆虐的半岛上，看起来确实很有吸引力。 我必须先前往马德里，但从西班牙首都飞往达赫拉的往返航班起价仅为 30 欧元（35 美元）。 还有数十种住宿选择，从旅馆到全新的豪华度假胜地，该地区被誉为摩洛哥的隐藏宝石。 但是，不管广告和网站怎么说，任何前来此行的游客都将登陆世界上持续时间最长的领土争端之一。 这是因为达赫拉位于西撒哈拉，该地区被联合国列为“非自治领土”。这意味着当地居民无法自我管理。 相反，西撒哈拉约 80% 的地区由其北部邻国摩洛哥占领和管理。摩洛哥认为西撒哈拉是其主权领土的一部分，称其为“南部省份”。 联合国一直在推动解决这场长达50年的争端，包括举行全民公投，但该地区的土著人民却始终无法为自己的未来投票。 人权组织和法律专家告诉英国广播公司，从国际法的角度来看，将西撒哈拉宣传和标记为摩洛哥的一部分引起了严重关切，并促进了摩洛哥占领的合法化。 摩洛哥旅游部的数据显示，过去 7 年前往摩洛哥控制的西撒哈拉的游客数量增长了 50% 以上。他们从 2019 年的 490,297 人跃升至 2025 年的 743,133 人。 空中航线的扩大推动了这一繁荣。除了摩洛哥国家航空公司摩洛哥皇家航空外，瑞安航空、法国泛航航空和宾特加那利航空等航空公司现在分别运营从马德里、巴黎和加那利群岛出发的直飞航线。 29 岁的汤姆·拉克 (Tom Ruck) 是一位英国游客，最近乘坐瑞安航空 (Ryanair) 从马德里飞往达赫拉 (Dakhla)。 “已经有相当多的度假村正在建设中，但它们却非常非常空”他说。 鲁克补充说，“还有一些其他游客来参加夏季家庭度假之类的活动”，但“绝对感觉它还处于起步阶段”。 他的护照上有摩洛哥的印章，并说摩洛哥的国旗飘扬在整个城市。 近年来，摩洛哥政府大力投资发展西撒哈拉旅游业。这吸引了航空公司，瑞安航空和法国泛航航空都将西撒哈拉境内的目的地列为摩洛哥的一部分。 法国泛航空告诉英国广播公司，该公司“根据当局的授权运营飞往达赫拉的航班”......

title.en: Trump tells US negotiators 'not to rush' into peace deal with Iran
title.zh: 特朗普告诉美国谈判代表“不要急于”与伊朗达成和平协议

summary.en: The US president has instructed negotiators not to hasten a peace agreement with Iran, tempering expectations for a permanent ceasefire, despite earlier indications that a deal was largely complete.
summary.zh: 美国总统指示谈判代表不要急于与伊朗达成和平协议，这降低了对永久停火的期望，尽管此前曾表示协议已“基本谈妥”。

body.en:
United States President Donald Trump said the US will not rush into any deal with Iran, as his administration played down hopes of an imminent breakthrough in the three-month-old war that had been raised a day earlier.

The US blockade on Iranian ships in the Strait of Hormuz would "remain in full force and effect until an agreement is reached, certified, and signed", Trump wrote on Truth Social on Monday morning.

"The negotiations are proceeding in an orderly and constructive manner, and I have informed my representatives not to rush into a deal," he said.

There was no immediate response from Iran's government. But Tasnim news agency, which is linked to Iran's Revolutionary Guards, said the US was still obstructing parts of a potential deal, including Iran's demand for the release of frozen funds.

A day earlier, Trump said the US and Iran had "largely negotiated" a memorandum of understanding on a peace deal that would reopen the Strait of Hormuz, which before the conflict carried one-fifth of global oil and liquefied natural gas shipments.

Trump, whose approval ratings have been hit by the war's impact on US energy prices, has repeatedly played up the prospect of an agreement to end the conflict that the US and Israel started on 28 February. A tenuous ceasefire has been in place since early April.

The two sides remain at odds on several difficult issues, such as Iran's nuclear ambitions, Israel's war in Lebanon with the Iranian-backed Hezbollah militia and Iran's demands for the lifting of sanctions and the release of tens of billions of dollars of Iranian oil revenues frozen in foreign banks.

A senior Trump administration official told reporters an agreement would not be signed on Sunday, saying the Iranian system did not move fast enough.

But he outlined what he said were the latest contours of what was being negotiated.

The official, speaking on the condition of anonymity, said Iran had agreed "in principle" to open the Strait of Hormuz, in exchange for the United States lifting its naval blockade, and to dispose of Iran's highly enriched uranium.

He said the US understood Iran's Supreme Leader Ayatollah Mojtaba Khamenei had endorsed the broad template of the deal.

There was no immediate confirmation from Iran or elaboration on what an "in principle" agreement meant.

The US official said the US envisioned first reopening the strait and lifting the US naval blockade.

That would "take that economic pressure out of the world economy, and then you negotiate the mechanism by which they will give up various parts of the nuclear programme, and yes, of course, we would contemplate some time limit," the official said.

He pushed back on suggestions that Iran has not accepted disposing of its stockpiled enriched uranium.

reflection.en: The pursuit of peace often involves complex negotiations and requires sustained effort from all parties. This news reminds us that while peace is a shared aspiration, its realization depends on the consistent will and commitment of those involved. Even when paths to agreement seem clear, the journey towards lasting peace can face unexpected delays or shifts...
reflection.zh: 追求和平常常涉及复杂的谈判，需要各方持续的努力。这则新闻提醒我们，虽然和平是共同的愿望，但它的实现取决于相关各方持续的意愿和承诺。即使通往协议的道路看似清晰，迈向持久和平的旅程仍可能面临意想不到的延误或决心的动摇。

title.en: Madrid protesters decry rising rents and housing shortage
title.zh: 马德里抗议者谴责租金上涨和住房短缺

summary.en: Protesters in Madrid are voicing concerns over escalating rents and a severe housing shortage, issues exacerbated by increased demand from tourism and population growth due to immigration.
summary.zh: 马德里抗议者对租金上涨和严重的住房短缺表示担忧，这些问题因旅游业和移民带来的人口增长而加剧。

body.en:
Housing has long ranked among the top concerns in Spain, where demand has risen because of tourism and immigration-driven population growth.

Thousands of people marched through Spain's capital,  Madrid , on Sunday, protesting soaring rents, high home prices and a growing housing shortage.

Organizers said more than 100,000 people joined the march, while authorities put the figure at about 23,000.

The demonstration, organized by the Madrid Tenants' Union and backed by Spain's two main trade unions, comes despite recent action by Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez's government to tackle the housing crisis .

"Housing measures, although some are moving in the right direction, are advancing at a snail's pace, while the housing crisis is escalating rapidly," Unai Sordo, secretary general of the CCOO union, said.

Spain's central bank says that between 2021 and 2025, the number of new households grew faster than the number of new homes built, leading to a shortage of about 700,000 homes.

"More and more people are being forced into overcrowded conditions, having to live in shared rooms or even with other families," a spokesman for the tenants' union, Fernando de los Santos, told the AFP news agency.

According to the EU statistics agency Eurostat, housing costs rose nearly 13% year-on-year in 2025.

To help counter this, the government last month approved a new plan worth 7 billion euros ($8.23 billion) to build more public housing over the next four years. It also includes assistance for young renters and homebuyers.

Another key demand from protesters is a tougher government crackdown on tourist rentals .

Holiday homes have surged in city centers, outpacing hotel growth for years during Spain's tourism boom, but locals say the spread of holiday rentals is pushing up rents and property prices.

Authorities are now tightening rules as pressure mounts to protect housing for residents.

title.en: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
title.zh: 新的中国监控系统让外国人无处藏身

summary.en: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed details to DW about China's new high-tech policing system. This system uses facial recognition and other technologies to track individuals, including foreigners, and compile comprehensive profiles, leaving them with no privacy.
summary.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声披露了中国新型高科技警务系统的细节。该系统利用面部识别和其他技术追踪包括外国人在内的个人，并建立全面的“综合档案”，使他们无处藏身。

body.en:
A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

When a cybersecurity researcher known by the pseudonym NetAskari recently clicked on a tab labeled "Inquiry for journalist files" on an unsecured Chinese web dashboard, he expected to see a jumble of auto-generated mock data.

Instead, familiar faces popped up on the screen. It was a comprehensive database of almost every foreign journalist based in Beijing around 2021, including official passport photos taken at the entry/exit bureau, private cellphone numbers, visa details and dates of birth. He also found his own exact personal information lying dormant on this Chinese police watch list.

"It was more interesting than shocking," NetAskari told DW. "When you work as a journalist in China , you basically assume you are always on their radar. But what surprised me was simply how easy it was to access this highly sensitive system."

What NetAskari had stumbled upon is part modern China's emerging system of "holographic profiles."

He had unwittingly accessed a demonstration version of a remote tracking system designed for the Public Security Bureau in Zhangjiakou, the Hebei province city that hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics.

Though it was only a test panel, it was populated with real datasets, clearly outlining the trajectory of China's state surveillance machine, which is rapidly evolving from a network of simple street cameras into a data-fused, 24/7, predictive social control behemoth.

For years, China has operated the world's most extensive CCTV network. A massive initiative known as the "Xueliang" (Bright Eyes) project aims to merge these isolated islands of surveillance spread across the country.

But the data on the Zhangjiakou police dashboard shows the granular detail with which authorities can track an individual.

This system no longer relies solely on police cameras on street corners; it accurately records the specific train carriage and seat number a target occupies when arriving from Beijing or Shanghai, for example.

It even synchronizes photos taken by facial-recognition ticket gates at local ski resorts directly into its tracking mechanism. The movements of the researcher's acquaintances who recently skied in Zhangjiakou were precisely flagged and mapped out with detailed trajectories in the system.

"The idea is simply to process as much data as possible from as many sensors as possible in real time," the researcher noted.

The system logs daily behaviors like gasoline consumption, regular shopping locations and whether an individual frequently visits "petition areas."

This massive data-fusion effort...
body.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声透露了中国新型高科技警务的细节。从滑雪场面部识别到火车座位，该系统可以跟踪任何人并编制“整体档案”。 当一位化名 NetAskari 的网络安全研究人员最近点击一个不安全的中文网络仪表板上标有“查询记者档案”的选项卡时，他预计会看到一堆自动生成的模拟数据。 取而代之的是，熟悉的面孔出现在屏幕上。这是一个综合数据库，包含 2021 年左右驻京的几乎所有外国记者，包括在出入境局拍摄的官方护照照片、私人手机号码、签证详细信息和出生日期。他还发现自己的确切个人信息隐藏在这份中国警方的监视名单上。 “这比令人震惊更有趣，”内特阿斯卡里告诉德国之声。 “当你在中国担任记者时，你基本上会认为你总是在他们的监视范围内。但令我惊讶的是访问这个高度敏感的系统是多么容易。” NetAskari 偶然发现的是现代中国新兴的“全息轮廓”系统的一部分。 他无意中访问了为主办 2022 年冬季奥运会的河北省张家口市公安局设计的远程跟踪系统演示版本。 虽然它只是一个测试面板，但它填充了真实的数据集，清楚地概述了中国国家监控机器的轨迹，该机器正在从简单的街道摄像头网络迅速演变为数据融合的、24/7、预测性的社会控制庞然大物。 多年来，中国运营着世界上最广泛的闭路电视网络。一项名为“雪亮”（明亮的眼睛）项目的大规模倡议旨在合并这些分布在全国各地的监视孤岛。 但张家口警方仪表板上的数据显示了当局可以追踪个人的详细信息。 该系统不再仅仅依赖于街角的警察摄像头；例如，它可以准确记录目标从北京或上海抵达时所乘坐的具体火车车厢和座位号。 它甚至将当地滑雪场的面部识别检票口拍摄的照片直接同步到其跟踪机制中。研究人员最近在张家口滑雪的熟人的动作被精确标记，并在系统中绘制出详细的轨迹。 研究人员指出：“这个想法只是实时处理来自尽可能多的传感器的尽可能多的数据。” 该系统会记录日常行为，例如汽油消耗、常规购物地点以及个人是否经常访问“请愿区”。 这种大规模的数据融合工作......

reflection.en: The news of pervasive surveillance systems reminds us of the vulnerability of individuals when powerful systems are deployed without restraint. It highlights the importance of governance that protects human dignity and freedom, rather than creating an environment where people feel constantly exposed and helpless.
reflection.zh: 普遍存在的监控系统提醒我们，当强大的系统不受限制地部署时，个人是多么脆弱。这突显了保护人类尊严和自由的治理的重要性，而不是制造一个让人感到持续暴露和无助的环境。

title.en: Displaced Ukrainians risk home seizure under Russian law
title.zh: 流离失所的乌克兰人面临俄罗斯法律下的房屋没收风险

summary.en: Russia is tightening control over property in occupied Ukrainian territories, requiring owners to register under Russian law. Many Ukrainians say returning to do so would put their safety and freedom at risk.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯正在加强对被占乌克兰领土财产的控制，要求业主根据俄罗斯法律进行登记。许多流离失所的乌克兰人表示，如果他们返回办理登记，将危及他们的安全和自由。

body.en:
Russia is tightening control over property in occupied Ukrainian territories, requiring owners to register under Russian law. Many Ukrainians say returning to do so would put their safety and freedom at risk.

Russian authorities have granted owners of land and real estate in the Russian-occupied territories of Ukraine until July 1, 2026 to claim ownership of any property originally registered under Ukrainian law.

But to re-register their property in the Russian land registry, owners have to appear in person and present a Russian passport as proof of their identity — an impossibility for many Ukrainians.

"It breaks my heart," said Lyudmila (name changed.) "I built my whole life there. My business was bombed. I had to leave behind everything I held dear. I had hoped they would at least let me keep my apartment."

In 2022, she fled the Zaporizhzhia region to the Ukrainian capital, Kyiv, to escape the Russian occupation . But she continued to pay the utility bills for her home. "At first, a neighbor kept an eye on the apartment, and after that my ex-husband did. Then I decided that starting with New Year's Day, I would stop paying the bills. I don't know if I was even right to pay them in the first place," Lyudmyla told DW. "I am waiting for my city to be liberated."

Until then, she doesn't intend to go home to re-register her apartment with the occupying authorities. "First of all, I don't want to see the occupiers because I was there and I know what these people are like. And I don't want to lose years of my life and get stressed. Second, I don't even know if they would let me in."

Russian occupiers started seizing the homes of Ukrainians in occupied territories in 2014. Seven years, in 2021, the authorities of the self-proclaimed Donetsk People's Republic began classifying abandoned residential properties as "ownerless." These can now be sold or seized by "courts."

In 2024, the occupying authorities went a step further and defined as "ownerless" apartments or buildings that have been vacant for more than a year, for which no utility bills have been paid, and whose owners do not appear in Russian land registries. They justified the decision by saying that the security of the property itself was at risk. At the end of 2025, this approach was legalized at the federal level in Russia. "Ownerless" apartments can now be transferred to Russian citizens.

It's almost impossible to determine how many apartments Russian authorities have already taken in the occupied Ukrainian territories. title.en: 'I shouted run': Witness recalls moment of China's worst mine disaster in years
title.zh: “我大喊快跑”：目击者回忆中国多年来最严重矿难发生瞬间

summary.en: A recent mining accident in China has been described as the country's deadliest since 2009, resulting in a significant loss of life. A witness recalled shouting for people to run during the incident.
summary.zh: 中国最近发生的一起矿难被描述为自2009年以来该国最致命的事故，造成了重大人员伤亡。一名目击者回忆在事故发生时曾大喊让人快跑。

body.en:
As emergency rescuers undertook a major rescue operation after Saturday's mining accident that killed at least 82 people in northern China, a wounded survivor said he heard no sound but smelled sulphur when the explosion happened.

"I didn't hear any sound at all, but then a cloud of smoke appeared," miner Wang Yong said.

"When I smelled it, it was the smell of sulphur like when people set off firecrackers. When the smoke came down, I shouted for people to run," he said.

"After more than an hour, I came to on my own, and then I woke up the person next to me" and got out, he told Chinese broadcaster CCTV.

The blast at the Liushenyu shaft in Shanxi province was the country's worst mining disaster in nearly two decades, with 247 workers underground at the time, according to Chinese media.

Hundreds of rescuers have rushed to the site, with medical teams taking 128 people to the hospital as of Saturday evening (local time), loaded into ambulances and carried on stretchers. Two people still remain missing.

Agence France-Presse journalists saw police blocking the road leading to the mine late Saturday, allowing only authorised vehicles to enter.

Helmeted rescuers took turns descending into the shaft overnight to look for the two missing workers, state media reported.

"As long as there is hope, we will make every possible effort," one rescuer told Xinhua news agency.

Chinese authorities launched an investigation into the blast, the worst since 2009 when 108 people were killed in a mine explosion in northeastern Heilongjiang province.

Preliminary findings showed the company operating the mine had committed "serious illegal violations", authorities told a press conference.

"Those found responsible will be severely punished in accordance with laws and regulations," they added.

A person "responsible for" the company involved had been "placed under control in accordance with the law", Xinhua reported.

The State Council, China's cabinet, ordered nationwide "tough crackdowns on illegal and unlawful activities", including the falsification of safety data, unclear headcounts of underground workers and illegal contracting.

Shanxi, one of China's poorer provinces, is the centre of the country's coal-mining industry.

Mine safety in China has improved in recent decades, but accidents still occur in an industry where safety protocols are often lax and regulations are vague.

In 2023, a collapse at an open-pit coal mine in the northern Inner Mongolia region killed 53 people.

China is the world's top consumer of coal and the largest greenhouse gas emitter, despite installing renewable energy capacity at record speed.

body.zh: 周六，中国北方发生了导致至少 82 人死亡的矿难，紧急救援人员在开展重大救援行动时，一名受伤的幸存者表示，爆炸发生时他没有听到任何声音，但闻到了硫磺的味道。 “我根本没有听到任何声音，但随后出现了一团烟雾。”矿工王勇说。 “当我闻到的时候，那是硫磺的味道，就像人们放鞭炮时一样。当烟雾降下时，我大声喊叫人们快跑，”他说。 他告诉中国中央电视台，“一个多小时后，我自己醒了过来，然后我叫醒了旁边的人”，然后下了车。 据中国媒体报道，山西省六神峪竖井爆炸是该国近二十年来最严重的矿难，当时井下有 247 名工人。 截至周六晚间（当地时间），数百名救援人员已赶赴现场，医疗队已将 128 人送往医院，并装上救护车并用担架抬上。目前仍有两人失踪。 法新社记者周六晚看到警察封锁了通往矿井的道路，只允许经过授权的车辆进入。 据官方媒体报道，戴着头盔的救援人员连夜轮流进入竖井寻找两名失踪的工人。 “只要有希望，我们就会尽一切努力，”一名救援人员告诉新华社。 中国当局对这起爆炸展开调查，这是自2009年黑龙江省东北部矿井爆炸造成108人死亡以来最严重的一次。 当局在新闻发布会上表示，初步调查结果显示，该矿运营公司存在“严重违法行为”。 他们补充说：“对相关责任人，将依法依规予以严厉处罚。” 据新华社报道，涉事公司一名“负责人”已被“依法控制”。 中国国务院下令在全国范围内“严厉打击违法违规行为”，包括伪造安全数据、井下工人人数不明和非法承包等。 山西是中国较贫困的省份之一，也是全国煤炭开采业的中心。 近几十年来，中国的矿山安全有所改善，但安全规程往往松懈、法规模糊的行业中事故仍然时有发生。 2023年，内蒙古北部地区一座露天煤矿发生塌方，造成53人死亡。 尽管中国以创纪录的速度安装可再生能源产能，但它仍然是世界上最大的煤炭消费国和最大的温室气体排放国。 在中国寂静的沁源县，煤矿工人有时会在张的烤串店吃饭，尤其是在发薪日，事故已经发生……

In moments of such tragedy, we hold onto the promise that one day, all tears will be wiped away, and death, mourning, crying, and pain will be no more. This hope offers solace to those grieving and a vision of a future free from...
reflection.zh: 这场毁灭性的矿难消息带来了深切的悲痛，提醒我们生命的脆弱和突如其来的损失所带来的痛苦。在这样的悲剧中，我们紧紧抓住一个应许：有一天，所有的眼泪都将被擦去，死亡、悲伤、哭泣和痛苦将不复存在。这个盼望为那些悲伤的人带来慰藉，并描绘了一个没有此类苦难的未来。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: 'He thrives on controversy': The past and possible future of Israel's 'TikTok minister'
title.zh: “靠争议而兴盛”：以色列“TikTok部长”的过去与未来

summary.en: Itamar Ben-Gvir, known as Israel's 'TikTok minister' for his controversial style, has reached the highest echelons of Israeli politics. Despite his rapid rise, analysts suggest his future in this position may be short-lived.
summary.zh: 伊塔马尔·本-格维尔因其富有争议的风格而被戏称为以色列的“TikTok部长”，他已晋升至以色列政坛的最高层。尽管他迅速崛起，但分析人士认为他在此职位上的未来可能不会长久。

body.en:
Far-right Israeli national security minister Itamar Ben-Gvir was once again in the headlines this week after a video of him taunting detained activists went viral , drawing rebuke from world leaders and his own prime minister.

However, it arguably isn't the most notorious footage featuring the man some Israelis refer to as the 'TikTok minister'.

In November 1995, just weeks before then Israeli prime minister Yitzak Rabin was assassinated by an ultranationalist Jew opposed to peace talks with Palestinians, a teenage Ben-Gvir appeared on live television holding an emblem stolen from the prime minister's Cadillac and saying: "We got to his car, and we'll get to him, too."

Ben-Gvir has never been accused of any direct responsibility for Rabin's death. But he and the extremist who did kill him moved in broadly similar ideological circles, fiercely against the Oslo Accords that Rabin signed.

The two incidents are also only the bookends of a prolific array of provocative videos the 50-year-old has become known for over the years.

In August last year, he posted videos of himself taunting popular Palestinian prisoner Marwan Barghouti in his jail cell. Several months later, footage emerged of him mocking a previous group of captured Global Sumud Flotilla activists and accusing them of supporting terrorism.

Ran Porat from The Australian Centre for Jewish Civilisation at Monash University described Ben-Gvir as someone who "operates by creating these viral moments of 'this is Jewish power'."

"He thrives on controversy ... He thrives on these videos that depict him as powerful," said Porat, who is also a research associate for the Australia/Israel & Jewish Affairs Council.

However, Porat and other experts don't think Ben-Gvir is likely to remain in government after the upcoming Israeli elections, even if he might be increasingly popular among the nation's hard-right edge.

Ben-Gvir's televised 1995 threat to the prime minister took place when he was a member of a right-wing youth movement opposing the mid-1990s peace negotiations between Israel and the Palestine Liberation Organization.

In his younger years, he faced dozens of charges relating to anti-Arab incitement, support of proscribed organisations, disturbing the peace and other public-order offences, but was acquitted of most. He has eight criminal convictions, including support for a terrorist organisation and incitement to racism, one of which related to him carrying a sign reading "Expel the Arab enemy" in 2007.

He is a long-time settler in the occupied West Bank and, while working as a defence attorney before entering parliament, represented many Jewish settlers accused of violence against Palestinians.

Although he has been active in Israeli parliamentary politics...
body.zh: 以色列极右翼国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本-格维尔本周再次成为头条新闻，此前他嘲笑被拘留的活动人士的视频在网上疯传，引起了世界领导人和他自己的总理的谴责。 然而，这可能不是一些以色列人称之为“TikTok 部长”的最臭名昭著的视频。 1995 年 11 月，就在时任以色列总理伊扎克·拉宾 (Yitzak Rabin) 被一名反对与巴勒斯坦人和谈的极端民族主义犹太人暗杀的几周前，十几岁的本·格维尔 (Ben-Gvir) 出现在电视直播中，手里拿着从总理的凯迪拉克上偷来的徽章，并说道：“我们上了他的车，我们也会找到他。” 本-格维尔从未被指控对拉宾之死负有任何直接责任。但他和杀害他的极端分子在大致相似的意识形态圈子里活动，强烈反对拉宾签署的《奥斯陆协议》。 这两起事件也只是这位 50 岁的人多年来出名的一系列大量挑衅性视频的书挡。 去年八月，他发布了自己在牢房中嘲笑受欢迎的巴勒斯坦囚犯马尔万·巴尔古提的视频。几个月后，视频出现，显示他嘲笑先前被俘的全球苏姆德船队活动分子，并指责他们支持恐怖主义。 莫纳什大学澳大利亚犹太文明中心的兰·波拉特 (Ran Porat) 将本·格维尔描述为“通过创造‘这是犹太力量’的病毒式时刻来运作的人”。 “他在争议中茁壮成长……他在这些描绘他强大的视频中茁壮成长，”波拉特说，他也是澳大利亚/以色列和犹太事务委员会的研究员。 然而，波拉特和其他专家认为，本-格维尔在即将到来的以色列选举后不太可能继续留在政府，即使他可能在该国的极右翼边缘中越来越受欢迎。 1995 年，本-格维尔在电视上对总理发出威胁，当时他是反对 90 年代中期以色列与巴勒斯坦解放组织之间和平谈判的右翼青年运动的成员。 在他年轻的时候，他面临数十项与反阿拉伯煽动、支持被禁组织、扰乱和平和其他公共秩序犯罪有关的指控，但大多数罪名被无罪释放。 他有八项刑事定罪，包括支持恐怖组织和煽动种族主义，其中一项与他在 2007 年举着“驱逐阿拉伯敌人”的牌子有关。 他是被占领的约旦河西岸的长期定居者，在进入议会之前担任辩护律师，曾代表许多被指控对巴勒斯坦人实施暴力的犹太定居者。 尽管他一直活跃于以色列议会政治......

reflection.en: A leader who "thrives on controversy" often builds a platform on division rather than unity. While such an approach might lead to a rapid ascent, the wisdom of Scripture suggests that a foundation built on pride and contention is ultimately unstable. True leadership, grounded in humility and seeking the common good, fosters lasting influence and peace.
reflection.zh: 一个“靠争议而兴盛”的领导者，其平台往往建立在分裂而非团结之上。虽然这种方式可能带来快速的崛起，但圣经的智慧指出，建立在骄傲和纷争之上的根基最终是不稳固的。真正以谦卑为本、寻求共同利益的领导力，才能培养持久的影响力与和平。

title.en: Cuba receives China rice shipment amid US threats, blackouts
title.zh: 古巴在美国威胁和停电中收到中国大米援助

summary.en: Cuba has received a shipment of rice from China, which is expected to help alleviate food shortages. The island nation continues to face an economic crisis marked by blackouts and oil embargos, further complicated by threats from the United States.
summary.zh: 古巴已收到中国运来的一批大米，预计将缓解粮食短缺。该岛国持续面临经济危机，停电和石油禁运不断，而来自美国的威胁也使其处境更加复杂。

body.en:
Chinese aid is expected to alleviate food shortages in Cuba. But the island's economic crisis continues with blackouts and oil embargos are compunded by threats from the United States.

Cuba took delivery of 15,000 tons of rice donated by China on Sunday when the first of several promised shipments arrived at the port of Havana , helping to somewhat alleviate acute shortages on the Caribbean island.

"This noble gesture of solidarity will reach millions of consumers throughout all the provinces, in addition to our health and education institutions," Cuban President Miguel Diaz-Canel wrote on social media.

"The heartfelt ties of friendship and cooperation that unite [Cuba and China] are strengthened in crucial moments," he said.

Chinese ambassador Hua Xin said on Cuban television that the deliveries represent "the largest food aid" from China to Cuba "in recent years."

The shipment is the first batch of 60,000 tons of rice that Beijing has pledged to help combat a dire economic situation in the communist country which has only been exacerbated since the United States toppled Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro in January and halted exports of oil from Venezuela to Cuba.

On Sunday, up to 64% of Cuba was set to be subjected to simultaneous blackouts, according to data from the state-run Electric Union (UNE) compiled by the Spanish EFE news agency.

The Cuban government has recently acknowledged that the island's energy situation is "acute," "critical," and "extremely tense," with some blackouts in the capital Havana lasting 22 hours or more.

Last week, a record was set when 70% of Cuban territory was simultaneously without power during the moment of highest energy consumption. This week, the impact of these outages has fluctuated between 58% and 65% of the island.

The Havana government has called the current US oil embargo — which has been imposed on top of a general US trade embargo in place since 1962 — "genocidal" and has accused Washington of "suffocating" the island.

Cuba requires approximately 100,000 barrels of oil per day to meet its energy needs, only about 40,000 of which are supplied by domestic production. Various independent studies estimate that between $8 billion and $10 billion would be required to revitalize the Cuban energy system.

Meanwhile, US President Donald Trump 's administration continues to step up political pressure on Cuba , pushed by hardline Cuban-Americans in Florida, who have called for US-instigated regime change in their homeland for decades.

But ousting Diaz-Canel is unlikely to be as straightforward as the operation to remove Maduro in Venezuela in January, not least due to the lack of an obvious alternative.

body.zh: 中国的援助预计将缓解古巴的粮食短缺问题。但该岛的经济危机仍在继续，停电和石油禁运加上来自美国的威胁。 周日，古巴收到了中国捐赠的 15,000 吨大米，首批承诺的大米抵达哈瓦那港，这在一定程度上帮助缓解了加勒比岛屿的严重短缺问题。 古巴总统米格尔·迪亚斯-卡内尔在社交媒体上写道：“除了我们的卫生和教育机构之外，这种崇高的团结姿态将惠及所有省份的数百万消费者。” 他说：“将（古巴和中国）团结起来的真诚友谊与合作关系在关键时刻得到加强。” 中国驻古巴大使华欣在古巴电视台表示，这些物资是中国“近年来”向古巴提供的“最大规模的粮食援助”。 这批大米是北京方面承诺的第一批6万吨大米，用于帮助应对这个共产主义国家严峻的经济形势，自美国一月份推翻委内瑞拉总统尼古拉斯·马杜罗并停止从委内瑞拉向古巴出口石油以来，经济形势不断恶化。 根据西班牙埃菲通讯社汇编的国营电力联盟 (UNE) 的数据，周日，古巴多达 64% 的地区将同时停电。 古巴政府最近承认，该岛的能源形势“严重”、“危急”和“极其紧张”，首都哈瓦那部分地区停电持续22小时或更长时间。 上周，在能源消耗最高的时刻，古巴 70% 的领土同时断电，创下了纪录。本周，这些停电的影响范围在该岛的 58% 到 65% 之间波动。 哈瓦那政府称当前的美国石油禁运——这是在美国自 1962 年以来实施的全面贸易禁运之上实施的——是“种族灭绝”，并指责华盛顿“窒息”该岛。 古巴每天需要约10万桶石油来满足其能源需求，其中只有约4万桶由国内生产供应。各种独立研究估计，振兴古巴能源系统需要 80 亿至 100 亿美元。 与此同时，在佛罗里达州强硬派古巴裔美国人的推动下，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府继续加大对古巴的政治压力，几十年来，这些古巴裔美国人一直呼吁美国在他们的祖国煽动政权更迭。 但推翻迪亚斯-卡内尔不太可能像一月份在委内瑞拉推翻马杜罗那样简单，尤其是因为缺乏明显的替代方案。 “古巴的安全机构已经系统地瓦解了所有替代方案或......

The prophet Habakkuk found a way to rejoice in 雅伟 even when the fields yielded no food, offering a profound perspective on finding hope amidst severe scarcity. This enduring faith can sustain us when external...

title.en: China mine blast: Search and investigation continue
title.zh: 中国矿难：搜救与调查持续进行

summary.en: Chinese authorities have launched an investigation into "serious breaches" of security regulations following a coal mine explosion that killed at least 82 people. Two individuals remain missing after the incident.
summary.zh: 中国当局已对一起煤矿爆炸事故展开调查，该事故造成至少82人死亡，另有两人失踪，当局称事故原因系“严重违反”安全规定。

body.en:
Chinese authorities have launched an investigation into "serious breaches" of security regulations after an explosion in a coal mine left at least 82 people dead. Two people remain missing.

Authorities in China  on Sunday were still searching for two missing people and investigating a coal mine operator, after at least 82 people were killed in a gas explosion in a mine shaft on Friday.

A total of 247 miners were reportedly underground at the time of the blast at the Liushenyu coal mine in the northern inland province of Shanxi, with 128 subsequently taken to hospital.

While rescue teams continued to search for two missing people with the help of a robot which was sent into the shaft to test conditions, local officials accused the mine operator of "serious breaches" of security regulations.

A spokesman wouldn't specify what exactly the breaches were, but information reported by local media suggests several cases of operative negligence.

Some miners told the AFP news agency that they had had to purchase protective helmets with their own money while another report suggested that over half of the miners entered the mine shaft on Friday without having been properly registered with face recognition or issued with requisite tracking devices.

Officials have blamed "chaotic" scenes and "inaccurate" information provided by the mine operator for an initial death toll of 90, which had to be revised downwards, while state broadcaster CCTV reported that blueprints provided by the coal mine did not match the actual layout, hampering rescue efforts.

State media outlet Xinhua said one "responsible person" had been "placed under control" while the government in Beijing ordered a nationwide clampdown on "illegal and illicit activities," such as the falsification of security data, inaccurate tracking of miners' activities and illegal commissioning procedures.

Chinese President Xi Jinping called for a thorough investigation while a commentary in the official People's Daily newspaper on Sunday called for all regions and departments to learn from the accident and to "always keep safety in mind."

Shanxi Province is one of China's poorer regions and the center of the country's coal production. Despite the rapid expansion of renewable energies, China has the highest coal consumption in the world.

Mining safety in the country has improved over the past few decades; nevertheless, accidents continue to occur. In 2009, 108 people lost their lives in an explosion at a mine in the northeastern province of Heilongjiang.
body.zh: 煤矿爆炸造成至少 82 人死亡后，中国当局对“严重违反”安全规定的行为展开调查。目前仍有两人失踪。 周五矿井瓦斯爆炸造成至少 82 人死亡后，中国当局周日仍在寻找两名失踪人员并调查一名煤矿经营者。 据报道，山西省北部内陆省份六神峪煤矿发生爆炸时，共有 247 名矿工在井下，其中 128 人随后被送往医院。 虽然救援队在机器人的帮助下继续搜寻两名失踪人员，该机器人被送入矿井测试条件，但当地官员指责该矿经营者“严重违反”安全规定。 一位发言人没有具体说明违规行为具体是什么，但当地媒体报道的信息表明存在几起操作疏忽的案例。 一些矿工告诉法新社，他们不得不用自己的钱购买防护头盔，而另一份报告则显示，超过一半的矿工周五进入矿井时没有进行人脸识别正确登记或配备必要的跟踪设备。 官员们指责煤矿经营者提供的“混乱”场景和“不准确”信息导致最初死亡人数为 90 人，不得不向下修正，而官方电视台中央电视台报道称，煤矿提供的蓝图与实际布局不符，阻碍了救援工作。 官方媒体新华社称，一名“责任人”已被“控制”，同时北京政府下令在全国范围内打击“非法和不正当活动”，例如伪造安全数据、不准确跟踪矿工活动和非法调试程序。 中国国家主席习近平呼吁彻底调查，官方《人民日报》周日发表评论，呼吁各地区、各部门吸取事故教训，“时刻牢记安全”。 山西省是中国贫困地区之一，也是全国煤炭生产中心。尽管可再生能源迅速扩张，但中国的煤炭消费量仍居世界首位。 过去几十年来，该国的采矿安全有所改善；然而，事故仍在发生。 2009年，东北黑龙江省的一座矿井发生爆炸，造成108人丧生。

reflection.en: The tragic loss of life in the mine blast highlights the profound human cost when safety regulations are neglected. Jeremiah 22:3 reminds those in authority of their solemn duty to "do justice and righteousness" and prevent the shedding of innocent blood. As investigations continue, there is a deep longing for accountability and for measures that truly...
reflection.zh: 矿难中生命的悲惨逝去，凸显了安全法规被忽视时所付出的沉重代价。耶利米书22:3提醒掌权者，他们有庄严的责任去“施行公平和公义”，并防止流无辜人的血。随着调查的继续，人们深切期盼问责，并希望采取真正保护工人生命的措施。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: China launches three-crew spaceflight as part of lunar ambitions

reflection.zh: 当人类进一步探索宇宙，发射任务以拓展我们在太空中的足迹时，我们既被人类的聪明才智所震撼，也被宇宙的浩瀚规模所提醒。这项努力促使我们思考自己在创造中的位置，以及一个深刻的真理：即使在如此广阔的宇宙中，我们仍被雅伟所知并被祂眷顾。
